requirements.title: Variable definition contexts are the listed syntactic contexts
requirements.definition: A variable appearing in any listed context implies definition or undefinition of that variable, supporting prohibitions from INTENT, PROTECTED, and pure-procedure rules.

requirements.title: Function references in variable definition contexts must return associated pointers to definable targets
requirements.source: S19.6.7 p2, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF568.
requirements.definition: A function reference in a variable definition context has a pointer result associated with a definable target, and that target is the variable becoming defined or undefined.

pending.function-reference-result-pointer-associ: Positive control function returns an integer pointer associated with TARGET integer t initialized -777; execute f()=321 and assert t==321, with negative source controls changing only the result to a nonpointer or nondefinable target.
pending.function-reference-target-is-defined-var: Use the same pointer function in READ or assignment context, initialize target to -777, perform the context operation with value 654, and assert the target becomes 654.
